name: inventory-management-system
description: Termux-compatible Inventory Management System — React + Express + sql.js

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install --no-optional --omit=optional && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PORT=5000 HOST=0.0.0.0 node src/server.js
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run i18n:check && npm run build
